## Circular to Licensed Corporations and Registered Institutions

## Courses to Facilitate Former Practitioners to Re-enter the Industry and New Recognised Continuous Professional Training Providers

Please note that the SFC's Academic and Accreditation Advisory Committee (AAAC) has approved  courses  to  be  conducted  by  the  Hong  Kong  Securities  Institute  (HKSI)  and  the Vocational Training Council (VTC) to facilitate former practitioners re-entering the industry. Completion of the courses will serve as a new alternative to passing licensing examinations for  former  practitioners  who  have  left  the  industry  for  three  to  eight  years  in  fulfilling  reentry competence requirements.

The approved courses are:

| Re-entry Courses                                                       | Relevant Regulated Activities                                                  |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Certificate in Securities Dealing conducted by the HKSI                | • Dealing in securities • Advising on securities • Securities margin financing |
| Certificate in Derivative Dealing conducted by the HKSI                | • Dealing in futures contracts • Advising on futures contracts                 |
| Certificate in Corporate Finance conducted by the HKSI                 | • Advising on corporate finance                                                |
| Certificate in Asset Management conducted by the HKSI                  | • Asset management                                                             |
| Certificate in Leveraged Foreign Exchange Trading conducted by the VTC | • Leveraged foreign exchange trading                                           |

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

These courses are expected to be offered in the first quarter of 2005.  Further details will be announced by the HKSI and VTC.

In addition, the AAAC has recognized the Management and Executive Development Centre of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University, and the Hong Kong Capital Markets Association as Continuous Professional Training providers.
